Subject: Request: VM evidence bundle for SOC2/SIG audit - FinTrust

Hi David,

We are kicking off the SOC2 / SIG evidence gathering for our upcoming audit window and need a compact vulnerability management evidence package from Redwood that covers the following items for production environments: 

- Scan cadence and scope (credentialed vs unauthenticated, authenticated schedule)
- Retention of scan logs and who can access them (locations/paths)
- SLA/target remediation timelines by severity (Critical/High/Medium) and examples of recent CVE remediation attestations
- Proof of remediation for any Critical/High CVEs in the past 90 days (sample attestations or ticket links)
- Any compensating controls and exception process documentation

Can you provide a consolidated bundle (single ZIP) with an index and short attestation letter by next Wednesday (2025-07-23) so we can include it in our auditor packet? If possible include a CSV schedule of scans and a short signed note confirming the SLA statements.

I attached FinTrust_Audit_Q.docx with our requested evidence checklist. If anything is unclear, let us know — we can be flexible on format but auditors like a single organized archive.

Thanks,

David / Monica —

Attaching the artifacts and an attestation summary below. I included concrete examples for two recent items so auditors have a traceable chain. The ZIP (vm_evidence_index_20250716.zip) contains redacted scan logs and the index.

Attestation summary (signed by Vulnerability Ops):
- Scan cadence and scope: Production hosts are scanned with credentialed (authenticated) checks on a weekly rolling schedule. Full authenticated application scans run monthly. External-facing perimeter scans are done weekly without credentials.
- Retention: Raw scan outputs (Nessus/Tenable CSV exports) are retained for 24 months in a readonly S3 bucket: s3://redwood-prod-vm-logs/retention/ (access only to Vulnerability Ops and Compliance).
- SLA remediation targets: Critical — remediation or compensating control within 7 days; High — 30 days; Medium — 90 days. Exceptions must be documented with an approved risk acceptance ticket (owner + expiry).
- CVE remediation examples (sample attestations included in cve-attestations-20250716.txt):
  * CVE-2025-0421 (OpenSSL): Identified 2025-06-12, fixed in image build and deployed 2025-06-17 (5 days). Ticket: REDW-4217 (link redacted in bundle, full link available on request).
  * CVE-2025-0817 (third-party dependency libc): Mitigated via config hardening 2025-06-28, vendor patch applied 2025-07-14. Workaround in place from 2025-06-29.

Attachments included in ZIP: scan-schedule-2025Q3.pdf (PDF, 3 pages), cve-attestations-20250716.txt (text), vm_evidence_index_20250716.zip (zip, contains redacted CSV logs and index).

If the auditors need signed PDF attestation (letterhead), we can produce a short one-page signed attestation and include it in the ZIP.
